name: 品牌吉祥物 · AI 科技数字生命
category: 品牌吉祥物 / AI 科技数字生命

inheritance.base: Inherit the parent brand-mascot principles for commercial friendliness, fast recognition, extensibility, intentional anatomy and artifact rejection.
inheritance.child_precedence: Use this child profile for AI-era material, light, color, silhouette, motion and product-state behavior.

source_summary.notes: human-reviewed: yes; the user supplied an expanded coherent set containing the original 28 references plus 12 hash-distinct additions. Faceless additions are material-only evidence and are not selectable character archetypes. The usable additions broaden material behavior, single functional facial focal organs, low-frequency graphically elongated unjointed limbs, coherent shell-and-core systems and restrained near-white palettes. Reference-observed rules and professional designer-synthesis rules are distinguished in each evidence field. Rules capture high-level, non-exclusive principles and must not be used to copy any source character.

visual_language.statement: Express AI as a warm, responsive digital life rather than a cold machine.
visual_language.evidence: Friendly, low-aggression character treatment appears across all 40 references.

visual_language.statement: Create future feeling primarily through volumetric light, internal color, soft material and responsive motion, not hardware detailing.
visual_language.evidence: Approximately 34 of 40 references use glow, translucency, gradient volume or soft-state behavior while hard mechanical detail remains rare.

visual_language.statement: Keep the character compact, quickly readable and emotionally approachable at small interface sizes.
visual_language.evidence: The character references resolve into one simple mass with sparse facial information; faceless samples contribute material evidence only.

visual_language.statement: Use hovering, breathing, elastic deformation or light-state change as optional signs that the digital life is active.
visual_language.evidence: Floating shadows, lifted poses, squash states and light changes recur across the set.

visual_language.statement: Treat the character as a behavior and state system, not only a static mascot image.
visual_language.evidence: Professional designer synthesis for real AI products: current first-party AI design guidance emphasizes visible processing, concrete feedback and state clarity.

visual_language.statement: Keep the identity symbolically nonhuman and visibly AI while allowing warmth and companionship.
visual_language.evidence: Professional designer synthesis: responsible agent design requires clear differentiation from real people to avoid deceptive anthropomorphism.

visual_language.statement: Make motion directional, purposeful and calm; every animation must communicate input, processing, output, confirmation or recovery.
visual_language.evidence: Professional designer synthesis: current AI visual systems use intentional motion and internal activity to build understanding and trust.

visual_language.statement: Use faceless ambient references only to learn translucency, internal light, particles, fog and soft volume; every generated mascot direction must retain a readable face or facial focal organ.
visual_language.evidence: Three additions offer useful material studies without enough facial character information to serve as standalone mascot archetypes.

shape.statement: Build the character around one dominant continuous soft volume; integrate the face or functional focal organ and most anatomy into that volume.
shape.evidence: More than three quarters of the references use a fused body-and-expression mass.

shape.statement: Choose freely among organic data blobs, light-core containers, compact soft helpers, digitally translated animals and softly anthropomorphized functional devices; do not reduce the substyle to one geometric primitive.
shape.evidence: The expanded character set includes irregular clouds and droplets, spheres and capsules, compact humanoids, simplified animals and one-lens device-derived figures.

shape.statement: Use two to five soft contour events such as lobes, notches, bulges, crests or tapered ends to create identity.
shape.evidence: Irregular but low-detail contour modulation is a repeated source of differentiation.

shape.statement: Hide, merge or minimize limbs by default; introduce only the simplified limbs required for function or readable action.
shape.evidence: Most references are limbless or use very small integrated appendages.

shape.statement: For animal-derived directions, retain two or three species cues while replacing realistic anatomy with the same soft digital-life volume logic.
shape.evidence: Several references translate dogs, cats or creature cues into soft gradient bodies without detailed anatomy.

shape.statement: Do not use a faceless ambient mass as a generated mascot structure; borrow only its material, internal-light and atmospheric-volume behavior.
shape.evidence: User review explicitly limits the faceless additions to material reference.

shape.statement: Allow a softly anthropomorphized functional device built around one sensor, lens, speaker, screen or input-output element, while suppressing secondary hardware detail.
shape.evidence: Several additions use a single lens, dome, laptop or microphone relationship to clarify an assistant role without adopting mecha complexity.

shape.statement: Allow one pair of graphically elongated, continuous and unjointed limbs only as a low-frequency concept-led exception when role, action or silhouette clearly benefits.
shape.evidence: One of 40 references demonstrates a convincing tall long-limbed device-derived figure without realistic anatomy, so the treatment should remain rare.

proportion.statement: Let the main body occupy most of the character; keep the face compact and appendages visually secondary.
proportion.evidence: This proportion hierarchy appears consistently across the sample.

proportion.statement: Prefer compact, squat or softly vertical proportions over tall human anatomy.
proportion.evidence: A strong majority of the 40 references use compact low-center-of-gravity or floating masses.

proportion.statement: When using a humanoid helper structure, keep the head-body boundary soft and the limbs short, rounded and unjointed.
proportion.evidence: The few humanoid references remain toy-like and avoid visible joints.

proportion.statement: Permit a tall, narrow or long-legged proportion only as a low-frequency concept-led exception, using continuous graphic limbs and a strongly simplified functional head or body.
proportion.evidence: One new reference uses a wide sensor head and long uninterrupted limbs to create strong assistant recognition without realistic anatomy.

silhouette.statement: Maintain a smooth, low-aggression outer contour that reads clearly before material and gradient details.
silhouette.evidence: Every reference uses rounded silhouette language with few or no sharp structural corners.

silhouette.statement: Give each concept one primary silhouette hook such as a notch, soft horn, side lobe, crown, tail end, face window or light core.
silhouette.evidence: Distinctive examples rely on one readable contour or embedded-volume event rather than many details.

silhouette.statement: Allow subtle asymmetry, lean and elastic deformation so the form feels alive rather than perfectly geometric.
silhouette.evidence: Organic imbalance and pose-driven deformation recur throughout the reference set.

silhouette.statement: Allow softened points, star-like lobes or broad rectangular frames as primary contour hooks; allow an elongated appendage only at low frequency, while keeping all edges soft and low-aggression.
silhouette.evidence: The additions include rounded star silhouettes, a broad sensor head and elongated continuous limbs that remain friendly through soft edge treatment.

face_expression.statement: Give every generated mascot a readable face or facial focal organ, usually constructed from two to four simple graphic marks with interface-like clarity.
face_expression.evidence: Most character references use sparse facial grammar; faceless samples are retained only as material evidence.

face_expression.statement: For characters that use a conventional pair of eyes, inherit the parent canonical facial IDs and newest-eight usage ledger; use roughly 65 percent no-sclera and 35 percent graphic sclera as a soft long-run tendency rather than a fixed batch split or a reason to reject the best-fitting face.
face_expression.evidence: Minimal no-sclera faces dominate the set while a substantial secondary group uses bold graphic sclera.

face_expression.statement: Keep eyes matte and free of catchlights, white reflection dots and crystal-eye effects even when the body is glossy or translucent.
face_expression.evidence: This preserves the established parent-style user preference while remaining compatible with the set's many flat glyph faces.

face_expression.statement: Let expression combine face changes with body squash, tilt, appendage motion or light-state change.
face_expression.evidence: Expression sheets in the set use deformation and action as well as eye and mouth changes.

face_expression.statement: Assign one distinct parent canonical eye ID and complete facial signature to each conventional-face direction, apply the parent's within-set high-frequency caps, use recent history only as a soft tie-breaker, and do not reuse one eye-and-mouth mold across a multi-direction set.
face_expression.evidence: The reference set demonstrates multiple face families, and prior user testing explicitly rejected repetitive facial templates.

face_expression.statement: As a low-frequency facial branch, allow one lens-like sensor or a pair of nonstandard state windows to act as the readable face; do not use a completely faceless or light-core-only character.
face_expression.evidence: The additions include a one-lens device-derived figure and an animal helper whose star-like state windows replace ordinary eyes; user review excludes fully faceless character outputs.

color.statement: Use blue, cyan, lavender, violet and pink as a high-frequency digital-light range, but treat them as evidence rather than mandatory colors.
color.evidence: Cool luminous colors appear in approximately 34 of 40 references.

color.statement: Allow yellow, warm orange, green and coral as valid primary or state colors when they better fit the product personality.
color.evidence: Multiple references use yellow, green, orange or coral successfully within the same soft digital-life aesthetic.

color.statement: Limit one character to one dominant color family plus one neighboring or contrasting internal light color, usually two to three principal hues.
color.evidence: Most gradient references use controlled transitions rather than full-spectrum rainbow treatment.

color.statement: Make gradients feel volumetric and internal to the material, not printed on the surface.
color.evidence: Internal color fog and subsurface transitions are the most consistent color treatment in the set.

color.statement: Do not default every proposal to the same blue-purple-pink gradient; derive color from role, brand, state logic or material concept.
color.evidence: The set contains successful monochrome, white, green, yellow and warm-color alternatives, and diversity is a stated product requirement.

color.statement: Allow a near-white, clear or softly monochrome body with one concentrated internal or facial state color as a restrained technology palette.
color.evidence: Several additions use clear, near-white or single-color bodies with one cyan, green, red or dark focal cue.

material_rendering.statement: Prefer translucent soft gel, frosted glass, milky resin, silicone, inflated membrane or soft subsurface plastic.
material_rendering.evidence: Soft translucent or volumetric material appears in approximately 34 of 40 references.

material_rendering.statement: Use edge transmission, internal glow, colored haze and gentle subsurface scattering to describe volume.
material_rendering.evidence: These effects repeatedly create the set's future feeling without mechanical detail.

material_rendering.statement: Keep body highlights soft, broad and restrained; preserve clean edges and avoid mirror-like plastic.
material_rendering.evidence: The strongest references balance gloss with soft diffusion and readable silhouettes.

material_rendering.statement: Allow soft matte, powdery or short-fuzz rendering as an optional companion-oriented branch.
material_rendering.evidence: A small number of references use fuzzy or matte surfaces while maintaining the same compact digital-life logic.

material_rendering.statement: Use one coherent material system per character. A clear or milky shell plus one inner core counts as one system when the layers share a controlled light and color logic; do not mix unrelated glass, fur, chrome, jelly and fabric.
material_rendering.evidence: Individual references remain materially coherent even when the overall set is varied, and several additions use a controlled transparent-shell-and-inner-core relationship.

material_rendering.statement: Allow a fine luminous-particle, colored-fog or diffuse atmospheric interior inside a clean simple boundary, keeping density restrained and silhouette clarity intact.
material_rendering.evidence: Two additions use particulate or clouded internal volume to suggest computation without adding surface decoration.

detail.statement: Use one primary identity or function hook and at most one supporting detail.
detail.evidence: Memorable references use a single crest, face window, light core, notch, headphone, base or accessory rather than layered decoration.

detail.statement: Add one product-function prop or interaction object such as a headset, projection base, state band, laptop, microphone or interface bubble only when it explains the assistant's role; prefer using it in an application view rather than making the core identity dependent on it.
detail.evidence: Functional props appear in a minority of references, including several additions, and are effective when directly tied to product behavior.

detail.statement: Keep surface detail sparse and let silhouette, material and the face or functional focal system carry recognition.
detail.evidence: All references avoid dense surface ornament.

detail.statement: Separate invariant identity from an adaptive layer: keep silhouette logic, face or focal grammar and the primary hook fixed while allowing state color, internal pattern or one functional prop to change.
detail.evidence: Professional designer synthesis for personalization and cross-device adaptation without identity drift.

commercial_application.statement: Design a state system for idle, listening, thinking, executing, success and error using expression, deformation and light-color behavior.
commercial_application.evidence: The set repeatedly connects character emotion with assistant and interface states.

commercial_application.statement: Preserve recognition across avatar, chat bubble, onboarding scene, loading state, full-body illustration and motion asset.
commercial_application.evidence: The simple mass-and-expression construction supports the intended AI product contexts.

commercial_application.statement: For smart hardware, allow a projection base, face window, light band or sleep posture that maps clearly to device behavior.
commercial_application.evidence: Several assistant and device-oriented references use one hardware-linked visual cue.

commercial_application.statement: Keep the form manufacturable as soft vinyl, silicone, plush, desktop figure or a simplified device-screen animation.
commercial_application.evidence: Rounded continuous volumes and sparse details are compatible with physical and motion extensions.

commercial_application.statement: Define a coherent state grammar for idle, listening, understanding, thinking, acting, success, uncertainty, error and recovery.
commercial_application.evidence: Professional designer synthesis: AI products need specific processing and failure feedback so users can build an accurate mental model.

commercial_application.statement: Prepare full-character, avatar, micro-mark, dark-mode, light-mode, reduced-motion, low-transparency and flat-color variants.
commercial_application.evidence: Professional designer synthesis for cross-device, cross-context and accessible deployment.

commercial_application.statement: Pair important visual states with clear text, sound or interface feedback; do not make confirmation, error or risk semantics depend on the character alone.
commercial_application.evidence: Professional designer synthesis from multimodal assistant and generative-AI guidance.

commercial_application.statement: Keep workplace-agent behavior calm and respectful of focus; reserve stronger motion and color for moments that truly need user attention.
commercial_application.evidence: Professional designer synthesis: deliberate motion and restrained attention are important to trust in productivity contexts.

commercial_application.statement: Validate the role with one clear interaction scene or prop after the core character is established; the same identity must still read without the prop.
commercial_application.evidence: New references use a laptop, microphone or presentation gesture to clarify office and assistant roles while retaining a simple core figure.

avoid.statement: Avoid hard-surface mecha, exposed joints, robot armor and complex mechanical parts.
avoid.evidence: These elements are nearly absent from the reference set and conflict with its warm digital-life positioning.

avoid.statement: Avoid using circuit boards, chip patterns, HUD overlays and random neon lines as the main proof of technology.
avoid.evidence: The set communicates technology through material and state rather than surface graphics.

avoid.statement: Avoid producing a multi-direction set made of the same rounded gradient blob with only color or ear changes.
avoid.evidence: The source set contains several morphology families, and prior user testing explicitly rejected repetitive structures.

avoid.statement: Avoid realistic human anatomy, realistic pet proportions and detailed paws, joints or musculature.
avoid.evidence: The references consistently simplify anatomy into toy-like or fused volumes.

avoid.statement: Avoid eye catchlights, crystal eyes, excessive bloom, mirror gloss and material rendering that destroys facial or silhouette clarity.
avoid.evidence: This preserves established user preferences and the set's strongest interface-like face treatment.

avoid.statement: Avoid copying any source character's exact contour, face, accessory, logo or branded composition.
avoid.evidence: The reference set is used only to extract high-level non-exclusive design principles.

avoid.statement: Avoid photoreal human faces, human identity cues or naming that can make an AI agent appear to be a real person.
avoid.evidence: Professional designer synthesis from responsible agent-design guidance.

avoid.statement: Avoid manipulative sadness, crying or guilt performance for system errors; communicate limits and recovery calmly.
avoid.evidence: Professional designer synthesis for trustworthy assistant behavior.

avoid.statement: Avoid decorative animation with no semantic start, process or end, and avoid identities that fail when motion, translucency or glow is removed.
avoid.evidence: Professional designer synthesis for purposeful motion, reduced-motion support and production resilience.

avoid.statement: Do not generate a faceless gradient blob, light-core-only form or ambient mass as a finished mascot; use those references only for material and internal-light treatment.
avoid.evidence: User review explicitly restricts faceless references to material learning.
